复用本场同一音频的声音分析，只为当前转写生成新人物版本，不再次运行模型。: Reuse this meeting's analysis of the same audio to create a new speaker version for the selected transcript without running the model again.
先选择本场已保存的声音分析。: Choose a saved voice analysis from this meeting.
已保存分析与当前会议混音不一致，不能应用。: The saved analysis does not match the current meeting mix and cannot be applied.
已保存分析与当前录音时间轴不一致，不能应用。: The saved analysis does not match the current recording timeline and cannot be applied.
已复用声音分析并另存人物版本；文字变化处仅使用仍有效的映射，缺乏边界时保留全文待: Voice analysis was reused to save a new speaker version. Changed wording uses only valid mappings; without a reliable boundary, the full text remains for confirmation. Earlier manual versions are retained.
本次已另存新分析版本；人物分组和代号可能与旧稿不同，请切换版本对照。旧版人工修正: A new analysis version was saved. Groups and codes may differ from earlier versions; switch versions to compare. Earlier manual corrections are retained.
仅在本场显示的名称: Display name within this meeting only
使用完整混音分析同场声音并生成独立版本。A/B/C 只代表本场声音分组，不推断姓: Analyze the complete mix and save a separate version. A/B/C identify voice groups within this meeting; they do not infer names or treat audio tracks as people.
选择已有转写后主动运行；没有可靠句内文字边界时保留整句并提示待确认。: Choose a transcript and start analysis. When reliable text boundaries are missing, the whole sentence is retained for confirmation.
当前为独立说话人版本。可在字幕回放与校订中修改正文并另存；单击下方字幕回听。再次: This is a separate speaker version. Edit wording in subtitle review and save a new version; click a subtitle below to listen. Running analysis again preserves this version and its corrections.
选择声音特征模型；自选文件请使用右侧按钮。切换后再次分析会另存新版本，不覆盖旧稿: Choose the speaker embedding model; use the button on the right for a custom file. Analysis with another model saves a new version and retains earlier versions.
已核对本地说话人模型的来源与许可: I have checked the sources and licenses of the local speaker models
将上方人物合并到此人: Merge the person above into this person
将这段拆出为新人物: Move this segment to a new person
人工确认句内换人: Confirm a speaker change within a sentence
先回听，再在下面完整文字的两个字之间放置光标，选择候选换人时刻及左右人物。不会按: Listen first. Place the cursor between two characters in the full text below, then choose a candidate time and the left/right speakers. Timing is never divided by text length; overlapping speech is not invented.
每次纠正都保存新版本。改名只影响本场显示；合并或拆出不修改发言正文。导出标签可在: Each correction saves a new version. Names apply only within this meeting; merging and splitting people preserve the spoken text. Toggle export labels on the review page.
选择一个带说话人的版本和段落，再修正人物归属。: Choose a speaker version and segment to correct its speaker assignment.
声音归属待确认；文字完整保留。: Speaker assignment needs confirmation; all text is retained.
本场人物；声音边界为估计。: Meeting-local speaker; audio boundaries are estimates.
先选择模型给出的候选换人时刻。: Choose a candidate speaker-change time from the model.
请选择一个已存在的本场人物。: Choose an existing speaker in this meeting.
说话人修正已另存新版本；原稿、父版本和内部人物 ID 保留。: Speaker corrections were saved as a new version. Original transcripts, parent versions and stable speaker IDs are retained.
